content.introduction: Parking Services manages campus parking permits, regulations, and transportation options.

sections.title: Parking Permits
sections.content:
Permit Types:
- Residential: $500/year (campus residents)
- Commuter: $300/year (off-campus students)
- Evening Only: $150/year (after 4PM)
- Motorcycle: $100/year

How to Register:
1. Log into Parking Portal
2. Register your vehicle
3. Select permit type
4. Pay online
5. Pick up or print permit

sections.title: Parking Lots
sections.content:
Student Lots (Blue Permit):
- Lot A: North campus
- Lot B: South campus
- Lot C: West campus

Garage (Any Permit):
- Central campus
- Covered parking
- 24/7 access

Visitor Parking:
- Metered lots
- $2/hour
- App payment available

sections.title: Regulations
sections.content:
Permit Required:
- Monday-Friday, 7AM-5PM
- Some lots 24/7
- Check signs for specific rules

Prohibited:
- Parking without valid permit
- Parking in fire lanes
- Blocking accessible spaces
- Overnight in day lots

Citations:
- First offense: Warning or $25
- Subsequent: $50-$200
- Towing for repeat offenders

sections.title: Alternative Transportation
sections.content:
Campus Shuttle:
- Free with student ID
- Campus Loop: Every 10 minutes
- Off-Campus: Every 20 minutes
- Real-time tracking via app

Bike Program:
- Bike share stations on campus
- Free short-term rentals
- Bike repair station at Union

Public Transit:
- City bus: Free with student ID
- Routes connect to campus

sections.title: Contact
sections.content:
Location: Parking Services Building
Phone: (555) 123-4585

Hours:
Monday-Friday: 7:30 AM - 5:00 PM

For Appeals:
- Submit within 10 days of citation
- Include documentation
- Decision within 2 weeks

content.conclusion: Consider alternative transportation - it's cheaper and better for the environment! Free shuttle and bike options available.
